name: Photometric and Color Consistency Losses
definition: Losses to enhance 3D consistency with the 2D anchor image, including frontal 2D photometric loss, 3D RGB loss, and regularization.
summary: Photometric and Color Consistency Losses enforce pixel-level color fidelity between rendered and ground-truth images, distinguishing themselves by directly minimizing radiance discrepancies rather than relying on structural or geometric regularizers.
